Real Estate Taxes
Thurston County
Nebraska
Real Estate Taxes
Property Tax Delinquent Dates 2026
The 1st half of 2025 taxes become delinquent May 1, 2026. For those who wish to pay their taxes by mail, postmarked dates will be honored up to April 30, 2026. Interest will be charged in our office at a rate of 14% beginning May 1, 2026.
The 2nd half of 2025 taxes become delinquent September 1, 2026. A postmark up to August 31, 2026 will be honored. Interest on the 2nd half will be charged in our office at a rate of 14% beginning September 1, 2026.
Taxes can be paid online at nto.us
A drop box is located in the alley of the courthouse for anyone wishing to drop off tax payments. Interest charges begin on May 1, 2026, and on September 1, 2026, when dropping off tax payments
To Pay Real Estate Taxes
We recommend using the following options:
Property Tax
Call our office with questions at:
402-385-3058
Pay Online
Mail
County Treasurer
PO Box 625
Pender, NE 68047
Drop Box
A drop box is located in the alley of the courthouse for anyone wishing to drop off tax payments.
Pay Real Estate Taxes Online
The county has made an agreement with MIPS Inc. to make Tax information and payment available Online.
This Tax information is being made available for viewing and payment Online.
Payments are allowed for current and back taxes.
Credit Card convenience fee is 2.35%
Minimum Credit Card charge is $2.00
E-check fee of $2.00 per transaction
